【Wrong Hands】 Claire wakes up in a messy bedroom, shocked to discover she is looking at her own reflection as Leo.
【The Hallway Encounter】 Stumbling into the school hallway, Claire in Leo's body runs into a classmate who treats her with unfamiliar, casual hostility.
【Face to Face】 Claire enters her own classroom and freezes upon seeing her adult body standing authoritatively at the chalkboard.
【The Silent Interrogation】 Leo corners Claire at the back desk during homeroom, demanding to know what kind of curse she placed on him.
【A Forced Truce】 Claire whispers instructions on how Leo must act as a teacher while Leo warns her about the impending principal inspection.
【The Pop Quiz】 Leo steps behind the teacher's podium and announces a surprise test designed to fail Claire in his body before she can intervene.
Possible Characters: • Claire — Female lead, high school literature teacher trapped in Leo's body • Leo — Male lead, rebellious student piloting Claire's adult body • Marcus — Supporting character, aggressive high school classmate
